combo_label: Barbecues × Gemstones & Jewellery × The Wizard of Oz

entries.clue: Third thing the witch whistles up: a black swarm of the honey-makers
Stiff circlet slid whole over the hand to jangle at the wrist
The maned one begs the humbug for it; the Dutch sort comes in a glass
Chunky sweet pickle spooned onto a hot dog, or the keenness you eat it with
Plucky little cairn terrier who leaps out of the basket and runs for home
Sky-blue stone set in silver throughout Navajo jewellery
Lacy openwork of fine twisted wire soldered into delicate patterns
Cook over the coals, or the barred surface that does it, scraped clean while hot
In Baum the great cat lets one out and the yellow guards turn and run
Linked tube of minced pork in a skin, best cooked slowly so the middle is done
Kiln-hardened coat of powdered glass that keeps its colour for centuries
